Hi Samantha / Rahul —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from my side:
- You're evaluating inference options to reduce per-request latency for transaction enrichment and to centralize model serving across teams.
- Primary goals: predictable costs, regional routing, and SOC2-ready audit trails.
- Success metric: cut 95th percentile latency by 30% and reduce token cost by ~20% vs current setup.

Next step: 30-minute product demo + short tech Q&A to cover routing, batching, and quantization tradeoffs. I can run the demo and bring our runtime lead if you want more depth. Proposed 2-3 slots:

1) Tue Jun 2 — 10:00—10:30 AM PT
2) Tue Jun 2 — 2:00—2:30 PM PT
3) Wed Jun 3 — 11:00—11:30 AM PT

Attendees I recommend: you (Samantha), Rahul (platform), me (AE), and our runtime engineer (optional). I attached a 1-page agenda and the mutual action plan doc you mentioned.

If none of these work, share 2 windows that do and I'll have Marissa (cc'd) send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
